lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six horizontal rows posterior to the fifth gill slit, extending toward the mid-body.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal rows of blobs to form distinct, grid-like anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two primary horizontal ridges visible along the upper flank, characterized by a distinct vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the superior edge and shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, high-contrast white spotting present across the entire visible surface of the left pectoral fin, with increased spot density along the distal margin.
